verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev tasks are plain async/await TypeScript functions, so ops users can write arbitrary code (expressions, functions, transformations) between task steps and pass data via triggerAndWait/handles, which covers data mapping/transformation in code. However there's no dedicated visual mapping UI, expression language, or formula system aimed at ops users specifically — this is a code-first dev tool, not a low-code data-mapping layer. Missing for 10: no built-in expression/formula language or visual mapper for non-developers, no explicit documentation of dedicated data-transformation utilities between steps, no independent evidence of ops (non-dev) users doing this successfully.
